payload.recallText: I begin my illustrious career in journalism in the Bronx as a reporter for the newspaper at Fordham University. I see this guy named Dean, and I ask him about the raising of tuition. He calls me a punk but he ends up getting pied in the face. I ask him to comment but he's angry with me now. At some point, he curses at me. After all this, I go to the editor to create a story about this encounter, and I come up with the character named Pie Man. He has a catchphrase and everything. It becomes a known story, to where a girl asks me about it, and ends up asking me if I am Pie Man. While I think about it this, I do end up answering that I am indeed Pie Man. She seemed intrigued.
